heading.description: Screen heading label for the settings page

scanUsageLabel.description: Settings row label for the scan usage figure

signOut.description: Settings row/button label that signs the user out

signOutConfirmTitle.description: Title of the sign-out confirmation prompt

signOutConfirmBody.description: Body of the sign-out confirmation prompt

signOutConfirm.description: Confirm button in the sign-out prompt

signOutCancel.description: Cancel button in the sign-out prompt

trash.description: Settings row label that opens the Trash screen

trashA11y.description: Screen-reader label for the Trash settings row

trashHint.description: Settings row subtitle for the Trash row

openOn.description: Settings row label for the screen the app opens on after sign-in and launch

openOnA11y.description: Screen-reader label for the Open on row; {{value}} is the current screen name

openOnHint.description: Screen-reader hint for the Open on row: what tapping it does

openOnPickerTitle.description: Title of the picker that chooses the screen the app opens on

openOnScan.description: Open on picker option and row value: the Scan tab

openOnWishlist.description: Open on picker option and row value: the Wishlist tab

openOnMyBooks.description: Open on picker option and row value: the My Books tab

openOnCancel.description: Closes the Open on picker without changing the choice

openOnSaveFailed.description: Error banner when the Open on choice could not be saved; the old value is restored
